extraction.comparison_type: top versus the bottom fifth of dairy protein intake

sample_size.excerpt: We examined consumption of animal foods, protein and calcium in relation to risk of prostate cancer among 142 251 men in the European Prospective Investigation into Cancer and Nutrition.

cases.excerpt: After an average of 8.7 years of follow-up, there were 2727 incident cases of prostate cancer, of which 1131 were known to be localised and 541 advanced-stage disease.
